notes: The case test_chicViewpointBackgroundModel.py runs: 43 reference points on both matrices, 1,001 relative positions, 86 values per distribution. Position, max value and mean value are compared at E0 and are byte identical. Size nbinom and prob nbinom are not compared as numbers (coordinator decision, 2026-09-13): class EN was withdrawn for them because the reference is not reproducible against itself. Reordering a distribution moves the fitted size by a median of 55 percent, and a held-out Python run fell outside the EN envelope of the other four runs in 66 values where the C++ fell outside in 30. They are judged by the two validators instead (validators/chic_background_model.py). Likelihood: the negative log likelihood of the C++ fit must be no worse than the worst of the 5 reference runs by more than T, the largest run to run NLL spread of the reference over the case's distributions. Measured on 2026-09-13: T = 0.0842 nats; the largest C++ excess over the worst reference is 0.0214 nats; the C++ is better than the best reference on 148 of 999 distributions; 2 distributions have an unbounded objective and match the reference's start point exactly. Downstream, class E5: the Python chicViewpoint and chicSignificantInteractions (--pValue 0.2 --xFoldBackground 1.5, dual) call 555 interactions from the Python model and the same 555 from the C++ model, Jaccard 1.000000; the control, a second Python run's model, also gives 1.000000.

Covers a reference point spanning four bins, whose downstream values the Python shifts by three relative positions (its data is three bins shorter than the range it is zipped with). Also covers two reference points whose windows are clipped by a chromosome end, and a three column line. Seven values per distribution. Position, max and mean are E0. Size and prob are judged by likelihood and downstream agreement for the reason given in the first case; under the withdrawn EN rule a held-out Python run and the C++ both fell outside in 82 values. With 7 values per distribution, 549 of the 998 fitted distributions have two or fewer distinct values. They are kept in the rule and in T, not skipped. One of them has three reference runs at size 7.2e14 and two at size 10, an NLL spread of 7.98 nats, and that is T for this case. Measured on 2026-09-13: T = 7.976 nats. Without the distributions of two or fewer distinct values T would be 0.0061 nats, and the C++ would still pass: its largest excess over the worst of 5 reference runs is 0.0013 nats. The C++ is better than the best reference on 120 distributions; 3 are unbounded and match exactly. Downstream E5 with --combinationMode single for the one matrix: 20 interactions from either model, Jaccard 1.000000, control 1.000000.
